title: Updated review: Skip this garbage
text:
Updated review: Skip this garbage. 2nd Update: It still works for the most part but tripped my breaker last night so in the middle of really cold weather, I woke up to a FREEZING room. When the heater does work now it makes a terrible buzzing noise starting out and then is loud and makes a constant loud hum/rattle once the fan kicks in. This thing is just garbage and it's barely a year old and already falling apart- ridiculous!

UPDATE: I think we've used this about a year now and the AC started a thing where it KICKS when it turns off. I know that's some sort of compressor problem but for an air conditioner that's been kept clean and not used that hard (just cools a bedroom)- it shouldn't be like this. THEN as if that isn't enough- yesterday it leaked all over my floor and shut itself off! It's drain pan is full and I'm going to have to attempt to drain it without having it go all over the floor as I can't move this whole thing and have it slosh the water out.
An air conditioner shouldn't have to be drained. This things still perfectly clean and I run an air filter in my room even- I don't know how this thing could be clogged with anything but when I googled it, it says something is clogged inside it. I don't know what to do with it and a repair person would charge what a new one costs so I think it's gonna be garbage now.
Other performance- The heater works great but if you have old electrical, I would skip this! I live in an old house that can't handle as much and I think from the way this acts when it kicks on- it must be using more than the standard 1500 watts on a space heater. I can hear my electric meeter make a hum when it kicks on. I was told it's not a big deal if the hum goes away and doesn't stay? I don't know but I don't feel comfortable running that. The air conditioner has the same effect- this is a LARGE unit.
================================================================

This is definitely for larger spaces and is a little noisier than I'd like for a bedroom. If you put it across the room from you then it might work in your room. Of if you're trying to drown outside noise out then maybe you don't mind the louder fan.

Things I love about it are the slender design of it, the fact that it can cool my bedroom in less than a minute... I love that it does heat too because I live in a state where we get all the seasons in one week often! So I can switch it from air conditioner to heater instantly. The heating on it works flawlessly and is soooo nice!

Really I have no complaints at all about this one! Don't force the vent open on top when you get it, it's electronic and opens itself when you power it on. (I didn't realize this and could have broke it but it didn't break after I pried it open luckily)

Built-in air conditioning, heating, fan speeds, and dehumidifying capability provide flexible and optimal home comfort, while the auto-evaporation technology evaporates any water the portable unit collects under most room conditions, eliminating the need to drain excess water. LED controls with included remote make it easy to clearly see and manage your settings from anywhere in your room. This portable AC installs easily in double hung or sliding windows with no cutting required and comes with easy-roll wheels for effortless mobility. Additional features like a washable filter, 24-hour on/off timer, auto louver, and easy-roll wheels offer ease of use and maintenance.
